findings.text: blocking: the corrected Measure paragraph states the ten files "ran on both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk", but head-arm-focused.log:1 records `rev=dea3758c1582cb7d688d5b2a3d0180bce507e4e6+worktree tree=/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/reckon-c8f839407e49/efd0ee8c-9d4e-4fa3-a440-ac05791d4758/a-producer-publishes-again-after-a-broken-config` — a worktree on GPFS, not an extraction on node-local disk; only base-arm-focused.log:1 names an archive (`tree=/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/.../arms/base (git archive of HEAD)`). Section 55's done_when names git archive extractions on node-local disk as its terms, so the page repeats the same class of provenance misstatement the prior blocking finding raised, and a reader cannot reconcile the head arm with the head commit.
